name: donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: A ring of rounded slices that sweeps in; tap a slice to bring it forward and read its share in the middle.

perf.budget: Slice paths are built once per data change; the sweep and the selection are shared values read by one Skia canvas.

a11y.reducedMotion: The ring appears complete and selection changes without the bounce.
a11y.screenReader: The ring reads as an image with every slice and value; legend rows are buttons with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Legend rows are 44 pt tall and full width; the ring itself is also tappable.
